headline: Share India Securities Limited: General Updates
sum: General Updates - We are pleased to inform you that pursuant to the filing of e-form INC 28 with the Registrar of Companies, the Scheme of Amalgamation of Silverleaf Capital Services Private Limited with Share India Securities Limited has…
detail: General Updates - We are pleased to inform you that pursuant to the filing of e-form INC 28 with the Registrar of Companies, the Scheme of Amalgamation of Silverleaf Capital Services Private Limited with Share India Securities Limited has become effective in accordance with its terms.
